title: OSCORE stores recreate missing rollback authority from mutable state
description: Security review of 0919/mamj: GatewayOscoreSenderStore::load and GatewayOscoreRecipientStore::load accept (state present, external floor missing) and recreate the floor from the ordinary state record. If the independent rollback authority is deleted/unmounted while a rolled-back state snapshot remains, startup silently establishes the attacker-controlled snapshot as the new floor. Fail closed whenever exactly one side exists; only (None,None) may initialize a fresh context. Add sender and recipient missing-floor restart tests.
